dialogues.jp: こっちにもいないか……。
dialogues.en: There's no one here either...
dialogues.text: There's no one here either...

dialogues.jp: おかしいな。
dialogues.en: This is strange.
dialogues.text: This is strange.

dialogues.jp: 俺の時計、狂ってんのかな？
dialogues.en: Did my watch stop?
dialogues.text: Did my watch stop?

dialogues.jp: 俺は、校舎にある時計を見る。
dialogues.en: I took a quick check of the school clock.
dialogues.text: I took a quick check of the school clock.

dialogues.jp: ホームルーム開始時間の５分前。
dialogues.en: 5 minutes till homeroom would've started.
dialogues.text: 5 minutes till homeroom would've started.

dialogues.jp: やっぱり、狂ってないよな……。
dialogues.en: My watch appears to be working fine...
dialogues.text: My watch appears to be working fine...

dialogues.jp: 今日、環が待ち合わせ場所にこなかったのだ。
dialogues.en: Tamaki and I had arranged to meet here today.
dialogues.text: Tamaki and I had arranged to meet here today.

dialogues.jp:
いつもは３０分前には必ず来ている環が、今日
は来ていない。
dialogues.en:
She's usually 30 minutes early, but today, she wasn't here
at all.
dialogues.text:
She's usually 30 minutes early, but today, she wasn't here
at all.

dialogues.jp:
ま、人間、たまには寝坊することもあるんだろ
うけど。
dialogues.en: Well, she's human after all, she could've just slept in.
dialogues.text: Well, she's human after all, she could've just slept in.

dialogues.jp: それにしても、遅いなあ。
dialogues.en: But she's still pretty late...
dialogues.text: But she's still pretty late...

dialogues.jp: ……何か、あったのかな？
dialogues.en: ...Could something have happened?
dialogues.text: ...Could something have happened?

dialogues.jp:
ひょっとしたら、風邪でもひいたのかもしれな
い。
dialogues.en: Maybe she caught a cold or fever...
dialogues.text: Maybe she caught a cold or fever...

dialogues.jp: まさか、事故なんて事は……？
dialogues.en: Or even perhaps, a traffic accident...?
dialogues.text: Or even perhaps, a traffic accident...?

dialogues.jp: そ、そんなはず無いよな。
dialogues.en: Gah, I shouldn't think about that.
dialogues.text: Gah, I shouldn't think about that.

dialogues.jp: 縁起でもない……。
dialogues.en: It'd be a bad omen...
dialogues.text: It'd be a bad omen...

dialogues.jp: 「あっ」
dialogues.en: "Ah!"
dialogues.text: "Ah!"

dialogues.jp: 校門の方から、環の姿が見える。
dialogues.en: I finally saw Tamaki's figure approaching the school gates.
dialogues.text: I finally saw Tamaki's figure approaching the school gates.

dialogues.jp: 俺は大きく手を振る。
dialogues.en: I gave a big wave at her.
dialogues.text: I gave a big wave at her.

dialogues.jp: 環は早足で、俺の元へと歩いてくる。
dialogues.en: She briskly walked up to me.
dialogues.text: She briskly walked up to me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさい遅れてしまって」
dialogues.en: "Please pardon my tardiness..."
dialogues.text: "Please pardon my tardiness..."

dialogues.jp: はあはあ、と息を切らせながら環が俺に謝る。
dialogues.en: She was panting heavily as she apologized.
dialogues.text: She was panting heavily as she apologized.

dialogues.jp:
別に走ってきたわけじゃないのに、何でこんな
に苦しそうなんだろう？
dialogues.en: She wasn't really running, why's she so out of breath?
dialogues.text: She wasn't really running, why's she so out of breath?

dialogues.jp:
おまけに、環の顔色は、血の気が引いてしまっ
ている。
dialogues.en: Her face was flushed with red as well.
dialogues.text: Her face was flushed with red as well.

dialogues.jp: それに、身体もだるそうだ。
dialogues.en: And her body seemed unstable.
dialogues.text: And her body seemed unstable.

dialogues.jp:
触れたら、今にも倒れてしまいそうで、危なっ
かしい。
dialogues.en: It seemed like she was on the verge of collapse.
dialogues.text: It seemed like she was on the verge of collapse.

dialogues.jp:
「大丈夫か？　なんだか、顔色が悪いみたいだ
　けど……」
dialogues.en: "Are you okay? You don't look so hot..."
dialogues.text: "Are you okay? You don't look so hot..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうでしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Is that so?"
dialogues.text: "Is that so?"

dialogues.jp: 環は、いつもよりも、か細い声で答える。
dialogues.en: Tamaki spoke, in an even fainter voice than usual.
dialogues.text: Tamaki spoke, in an even fainter voice than usual.

dialogues.jp: 明らかに、身体が参っている証拠だろう。
dialogues.en:
It was obvious that her body was being strained to the
limit.
dialogues.text:
It was obvious that her body was being strained to the
limit.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「最近、頭痛が少しひどくなっていて、……薬
　を飲んでもあまり効かないんです」
dialogues.en:
"The headaches have been getting worse recently... medicine
do not seem to have any effect."
dialogues.text:
"The headaches have been getting worse recently... medicine
do not seem to have any effect."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「学校、休んだ方がいいんじゃないのか？」
dialogues.en: "Why don't you rest for awhile at school?"
dialogues.text: "Why don't you rest for awhile at school?"

dialogues.jp: 環は、静かに首を横に振る。
dialogues.en: Tamaki silently shook her head no.
dialogues.text: Tamaki silently shook her head no.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……でも、今日も巫女部がありますし」
dialogues.en: "...There's the Miko Club..."
dialogues.text: "...There's the Miko Club..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「一日ぐらい、休んだって平気だろ」
dialogues.en: "It'd be okay if you take a break from it for one day."
dialogues.text: "It'd be okay if you take a break from it for one day."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「それに……」

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉様にお会いしたくて」
dialogues.en: "...I wanted to see you..."
dialogues.text: "...I wanted to see you..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ウフフ……」
dialogues.en: "Ehehe..."
dialogues.text: "Ehehe..."

dialogues.jp: 環は顔は、微笑んでいる。
dialogues.en: A giggle escaped from her lips.
dialogues.text: A giggle escaped from her lips.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、相当具合が悪いのか、顔はどことなく
暗い。
dialogues.en:
But it looked so out-of-place, with the condition she was
in.
dialogues.text:
But it looked so out-of-place, with the condition she was
in.

dialogues.jp: その様子が、どこか辛そうに見える。
dialogues.en: It pained my heart to see her this way.
dialogues.text: It pained my heart to see her this way.

dialogues.en: "Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「無理……しないでほしいんだ」
dialogues.en: "I... don't want you to push yourself so hard."
dialogues.text: "I... don't want you to push yourself so hard."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、自分の素直な気持ちを環にぶつける。
dialogues.en: I told her my honest feelings.
dialogues.text: I told her my honest feelings.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「俺に会いたいと言ってくれるのは、正直嬉し
　い、だけど……」
dialogues.en: "I'm happy that you wanted to see me so badly, but..."
dialogues.text: "I'm happy that you wanted to see me so badly, but..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「環が倒れてしまうことの方が、イヤだよ」
dialogues.en: "If it makes you collapse... it's not worth it."
dialogues.text: "If it makes you collapse... it's not worth it."

dialogues.jp: 環は、俯いていたが、ゆっくりと口を開く。
dialogues.en: Tamaki hung her head, and slowly opened her mouth.
dialogues.text: Tamaki hung her head, and slowly opened her mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「心配掛けて、ごめんなさい……でも……」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry for making you worry... but..."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry for making you worry... but..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「自分の身体のことは、自分が一番よく分かっ
　てますから……」
dialogues.en: "I'm the one who would know my body best..."
dialogues.text: "I'm the one who would know my body best..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「だから、大丈夫です」
dialogues.en: "So, I am fine."
dialogues.text: "So, I am fine."

dialogues.jp: 環は、一生懸命、俺に微笑もうとする。
dialogues.en: Tamaki gave me a smile with all she could.
dialogues.text: Tamaki gave me a smile with all she could.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、それがかえって、環の具合がより悪い
のではないか、と思えてしまう。
dialogues.en: But even then, she seemed so pained to do so.
dialogues.text: But even then, she seemed so pained to do so.

dialogues.jp: 見ていて痛々しい……。
dialogues.en: I couldn't bear to see it...
dialogues.text: I couldn't bear to see it...

dialogues.jp:
環は一体、何のためにそんなに無理をしている
のだろう。
dialogues.en: Why on earth is Tamaki pushing herself so hard?
dialogues.text: Why on earth is Tamaki pushing herself so hard?

dialogues.jp:
そうまでして、環が得たいものは、なんなのだ
ろう。
dialogues.en: It's not like she's gaining anything from it...
dialogues.text: It's not like she's gaining anything from it...

dialogues.jp:
支えてやりたいのに、俺は環の支えになってい
ない気がする。
dialogues.en:
I said I would support her, but it seemed like I was failing
at my job.
dialogues.text:
I said I would support her, but it seemed like I was failing
at my job.

dialogues.jp:
こんなに無理するまで、何が環を追い詰めてい
るのか？
dialogues.en:
What's driving her to the wall so much that she'd go to
these lengths?
dialogues.text:
What's driving her to the wall so much that she'd go to
these lengths?

dialogues.jp: 俺には、見当もつかない。
dialogues.en: I couldn't figure it out at all.
dialogues.text: I couldn't figure it out at all.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、力になってやりたいという想いだけが、
空回りする。
dialogues.en: Even if I had more power, I would still feel useless...
dialogues.text: Even if I had more power, I would still feel useless...

dialogues.jp:
俺は、環に『無理するなよ』としか、言ってあ
げられないんだろうか？
dialogues.en: Isn't just telling her not to overdo it, enough?
dialogues.text: Isn't just telling her not to overdo it, enough?

dialogues.en: "...Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "...Tamaki."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Is something the matter?"
dialogues.text: "Is something the matter?"

dialogues.jp: 環は弱々しく微笑む。
dialogues.en: Tamaki smiled weakly.
dialogues.text: Tamaki smiled weakly.

dialogues.jp: 「……授業、遅れるぞ」
dialogues.en: "...You're gonna be late for the lesson."
dialogues.text: "...You're gonna be late for the lesson."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes."
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes."

dialogues.jp: こんな言葉しか掛けられないなんて。
dialogues.en: I couldn't get it out.
dialogues.text: I couldn't get it out.

dialogues.jp: 情けない。
dialogues.en: I'm pitiful.
dialogues.text: I'm pitiful.

dialogues.jp: でも、何て言っていいのかわからない。
dialogues.en: But to be honest, I didn't know what to say either.
dialogues.text: But to be honest, I didn't know what to say either.

dialogues.jp:
どうして、教科書にはこういう日本語は載って
ないのだろうか？
dialogues.en: Why don't the textbooks teach this kind of thing?
dialogues.text: Why don't the textbooks teach this kind of thing?

dialogues.jp: 役に立たない、と、思った。
dialogues.en: I'm really completely useless.
dialogues.text: I'm really completely useless.

dialogues.jp: 俺は環の手を引き、校舎へと入っていった。
dialogues.en:
Dejected, I took Tamaki's hand, and entered the school
grounds.
dialogues.text:
Dejected, I took Tamaki's hand, and entered the school
grounds.

dialogues.jp: ◆無理をする環◆
dialogues.en: ◆Tamaki, Overdoing It?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Tamaki, Overdoing It?◆

dialogues.jp: 朝、環と待ち合わせをすると、環が来ない。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki and I arranged to meet in the morning, but she wasn't
there yet when I reached there.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki and I arranged to meet in the morning, but she wasn't
there yet when I reached there.

dialogues.jp:
しばらくしてやって来る環。聞けば、今日も頭
痛がしたのだという。
dialogues.en:
Eventually she arrived, and delivered to me the news that
she was still suffering from headaches.
dialogues.text:
Eventually she arrived, and delivered to me the news that
she was still suffering from headaches.

dialogues.jp:
俺が無理して学校に来ることは無いと言うと、
巫女部のこともあるけれど俺に会いたいからだ
ともいうのだった。
dialogues.en:
I told her not to push herself just to come to school, but
she wanted to for the club... and to see me.
dialogues.text:
I told her not to push herself just to come to school, but
she wanted to for the club... and to see me.

dialogues.jp:
嬉しいけど、そんなに、無理しなくてもいいの
に……。
dialogues.en:
I'm really happy she cares so much for me, but that's too
much...
dialogues.text:
I'm really happy she cares so much for me, but that's too
much...
